variants.name: .366 TKM Soft Point
variants.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM ammunition.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are soft point rounds.

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: .366 TKM Birdshot
variants.info:
Change the barrel and ammunition of your firearm into one that can fire .366 TKM.
.366 TKM was developed for the civilian market developed from 7.62x39mm, these are rounds with small pellets inside of them.

variants.name: Banana
variants.info: There's always bullets in the banana mag.
